name: Chongqi de NTR Hougong Shenghuo
source:
One day, after a woman cheated on you, you got desperate and got killed by a truck… Then, a demoness with horns on her head saved you and changed your face… But you had a debt of 20 million dollars! You had no choice but to help this girl with horns collect "love". But what was "love"?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1742470/]Steam[/url]]
